name.title: Name
name.description: Unique name for this agent in your catalog. Format: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and hyphens; must start and end with alphanumeric; max 63 chars per segment; optional single 'org/' namespace prefix (e.g. 'h/web-environment').

description.title: Description
description.description: What the agent does. Parent agents read this to decide when to delegate to it.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Environments the agent runs in. Each entry is a registered environment's id or an inline definition. At least one, at most one per kind.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that serves the agent. Defaults to the platform model if omitted.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Instructions appended to the agent's system prompt to steer behavior.

subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Agents this one can delegate to. Each entry is a registered agent's name or an inline definition.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skills the agent can draw on. Each entry is a registered skill's name or an inline definition.

start_url.title: Start Url
start_url.description: Initial URL to open. Null starts on a blank page.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the agent perceives and drives the browser. 'visual': act on screenshots by viewport coordinates. 'multimodal': the same, with the page also included as markdown text alongside each screenshot. 'text': read-only markdown with URL navigation, no screenshots.

Browser.title: Browser
Browser.description: A local web browser the agent navigates and acts on.

EnvironmentPage.title: EnvironmentPage
EnvironmentPage.description:
Named page subclass so OpenAPI emits a clean ``EnvironmentPage`` schema name.

``Environment`` is ``Annotated[Browser | CodeSandbox | MCP | Memory, Field(discriminator="kind")]``
and has no ``__name__``. Without this subclass, Pydantic titles ``Page[Environment]``
by repr()ing the type parameter, producing a 95-char schema name that leaks
Pydantic FieldInfo into generated SDKs.

agent.title: Agent

messages.title: Messages

max_time_s.title: Max Time S
max_time_s.description: Maximum wall-clock seconds the agent may run. Unbounded if null.

idle_timeout_s.title: Idle Timeout S
idle_timeout_s.description: Seconds to keep the session open for follow-up messages after each answer. Null ends the session as soon as the agent answers.

parent_session_id.title: Parent Session Id
parent_session_id.description: Id of the parent session, when this is a child run.

answer_format.description: JSON Schema the final answer must conform to. Null returns a free-form text answer.

usage_per_model.title: Usage Per Model

subagent_session_ids.description: Session ids of any subagents this session spawned.

ShareLink.title: ShareLink
ShareLink.description:
Public share URL for a session.

``share_url`` is a path; clients prepend the AgP host. Today this points at the
v1 share router (``/share/api/v1/trajectories/{id}``); will migrate to
``/share/v1/sessions/{id}`` once the v2 share router lands.

TrajectoryChanges.title: TrajectoryChanges
TrajectoryChanges.description:
Changes to a trajectory.

This represents a batch of updates returned by the polling API
when checking for new events and status changes on a trajectory.

Used to incrementally fetch new events without
re-downloading the entire trajectory history.

Attributes:
    status: Current status of the trajectory
    started_at: When the trajectory started execution (None if not yet started)
    finished_at: When the trajectory finished (None if still running)
    error: Error message if trajectory failed (None if no error)
    new_events: List of new events since the last poll (empty if no new events)
    answer: Answer to the trajectory (None if not available)

TrajectoryEvent.title: TrajectoryEvent
TrajectoryEvent.description:
Event from a trajectory.

Unified from agp_client and agent_platform.
Uses the richer agent_platform version with screenshot serialization.

Events represent individual actions, observations, or state changes during
trajectory execution. They form a chronological log of everything that happened.

Common event types:
- AgentStartedEvent: Agent begins execution
- AgentCompletionEvent: Agent finishes successfully
- AgentErrorEvent: Agent encounters an error
- AgentEvent: Generic wrapper for agent-emitted events (policy_event, tool_result, observation_event)
- LiveViewUrlEvent: Live view URL becomes available
- ChatMessageEvent: Agent sends a chat message

Attributes:
    type: The type/name of the event (e.g., "AgentStartedEvent", "AgentEvent")
    data: Event-specific data payload (structure varies by event type)
    timestamp: When the event occurred

TrajectoryStatus.title: TrajectoryStatus
TrajectoryStatus.description:
State of a session/trajectory.

Lifecycle::

    PENDING → RUNNING → {COMPLETED, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, INTERRUPTED}
       |        ↑  ↑
       |        |  └─────→ IDLE (interactive: agent waiting for next task)
       |        ↓
       └─────→ PAUSED

message.title: Message
message.description: Message text sent to the agent.

images.title: Images
images.description: Optional images attached to the message, as base64 data URIs.
